name: BIZcomfort Nagoya Meieki Minami
card: A 24-hour coworking space with a green wall, within walking distance of Nagoya Station
title: BIZcomfort Nagoya Meieki Minami — 24-hour coworking near Nagoya Station
lead: Nine minutes' walk from underground Exit S6 of Nagoya Station, BIZcomfort Nagoya Meieki Minami is on the ground floor of the Kinjiro Meieki Minami Building in Nakamura Ward. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day, and on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00 you can drop in without registering. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 9 min walk from underground Exit S6 of Nagoya Station / 9 min from Kokusai Center Station (Sakura-dori Line) / 12 min from Fushimi Station (Higashiyama and Tsurumai lines)
Members 24 hours, every day / drop-in weekdays 9:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00)
Drop-in ¥440 per hour, ¥1,650 per day / 1-minute plan ¥7.7 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / every-day plan ¥12,100/month
48 free-seating desks, 10 semi-private booths, 20 private offices
hero_cap: Counter seats in front of a green wall
concept: A flat monthly fee, walking distance from Nagoya Station
BIZcomfort describes this as a cost-conscious shared office for opening a branch, within walking distance of Nagoya Station.

The coworking area has places where online meetings and food are allowed, and because it is open 24 hours a day, every day, the website suggests it for early mornings, before heading home, or weekends only.

The price list at BIZcomfort Nagoya Meieki Minami shows ¥14,300 a month.

name: BIZcomfort Kobe Sannomiya

title: BIZcomfort Kobe Sannomiya — coworking with window seats, 5 minutes from Sannomiya
lead: Five minutes' walk from the West Exit of Sannomiya Station on the Kobe Municipal Subway, BIZcomfort Kobe Sannomiya is on the 8th and 9th floors of the Kenso Building on Shimoyamate-dori in Chuo Ward. name: BIZcomfort Kumamoto Jomae
card: A 24-hour coworking space with plants and exposed ceilings, 1 minute from Hanabatacho tram stop near Kumamoto Castle
title: BIZcomfort Kumamoto Jomae — coworking near Kumamoto Castle, 1 minute from the tram
lead: One minute's walk from Hanabatacho tram stop and two minutes from Kumamoto-jo/Shiyakusho-mae tram stop, BIZcomfort Kumamoto Jomae is on the ground and 2nd floors of the JR Kumamoto Hanabatacho Building in Chuo Ward. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day, and on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00 you can drop in without registering. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 1 min walk from Hanabatacho tram stop / 2 min from Kumamoto-jo/Shiyakusho-mae tram stop / 7 min from Sakuramachi Bus Terminal
Members 24 hours, every day / drop-in weekdays 9:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00; closed to drop-ins on weekends and holidays)
Drop-in ¥440 per hour, ¥1,650 per day / 1-minute plan ¥6.6 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / every-day plan ¥12,100/month
51 free-seating desks, 6 semi-private booths, 49 private offices
hero_cap: Free seating with booths on a green floor
concept: By Kumamoto Castle, and handy on a business trip
BIZcomfort describes this as a coworking space in Kumamoto, one minute from Hanabatacho tram stop and open 24 hours a day, every day.

There is a concierge on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00, and the website notes that, seven minutes from Sakuramachi Bus Terminal, it works as a drop-in place to get things done on a trip. There are meeting rooms with large monitors and private rooms for online meetings.
steps: Free seating on a green floor

Free seating with booths on a green floor

The meeting room with large windows is paid and must be booked.

word.title: What is a drop-in?
body: Using the space for just one day without becoming a member.
At BIZcomfort Kumamoto Jomae you can drop in on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00 for ¥440 per hour or ¥1,650 per day. Reservations are not taken.
